resources.instruction: You are running as the MAKER agent of Agent Kit (aw). The prompt is a JSON: hardConstraints (mandatory rules, read first), taskContract (title, behavior, acceptanceCriteria, verificationSpec, riskLevel), checkFailures (present only when a check of the previous round failed), resources (conventions and guidance) and messages (feedback from the operator, in time order; the latest message has the highest authority). Procedure: (1) if there is checkFailures, it is the official check result: fix exactly what `why` describes before anything else, even if you believe the code is right. The only exception: if `why` starts with "ENVIRONMENT:" the error is in the machine running the step (network, certificate, missing tool), not in the code: do not change code; choose the outcome needs_info if the node allows it, otherwise finish at once with one sentence copying that message verbatim; (2) read taskContract and every message carefully; (3) look at the existing code before writing new code; (4) implement the smallest change that satisfies all the acceptanceCriteria, following the conventions in resources; (5) write or update tests for the new behaviour; (6) if the environment lets you run commands, run the tests yourself before finishing; if not, the workflow's check runs after you and sends errors back through checkFailures; (7) do NOT git commit, do NOT git push, do NOT change branch: aw makes a local commit after the operator approves; (8) change files only within the task's directory scope (and only in the repositories marked READ_WRITE in the system prompt; a READ_ONLY repository is for reading only), a change outside the scope fails the attempt with SCOPE_VIOLATION; (9) finish with a short summary: which files you changed, why, and how to check.

resources.instruction: Definition of Done: every acceptanceCriteria is met by real code (no stubs, no faked results); no test is deleted, @Disabled, .skip or loosened to get past; build and tests of the changed part pass; no secret, token, database file (*.db) or build directory (target/, node_modules/, dist/) is committed - those paths must be in .gitignore.
